title: HANFORD 222-S LABORATORY – FINAL REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL
agency: ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF > ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF > EM-ENVIRONMENTAL MGMT CON BUS CTR
description:
The Department of Energy (DOE) is releasing the Final Request for Proposal (RFP), Solicitation Number (No.) 89303326REM000152, for the Hanford 222-S Laboratory procurement. The Final RFP can be found on the Environmental Management Consolidated Business Center (EMCBC) Hanford 222-S Laboratory’s procurement website at https://www.emcbc.doe.gov/SEB/Hanford222S. 

 Amendment 0001 to the Final Request for Proposal under Solicitation Number 89303326REM000152 has been posted. Offerors are responsible for reviewing these changes to ensure understanding of the requirements identified.
